claims.claim: An implementation intention links a defined situation to an intended action, often expressed as if-then. It differs from a goal intention: 'I want to read more' describes a desired outcome; 'if I finish lunch, I read one page' identifies an opportunity and action. Research supports implementation intentions in many settings, but they do not guarantee success and can be poorly suited to unpredictable situations. Include a realistic fallback that maintains autonomy.
